Name four causes of deforestation in Zimbabwe.
back: Firewood for cooking, curing tobacco, clearing land for farms and settlements, timber and brick-making.

front: Give three things a school can do to preserve resources.
back: Plant trees or a woodlot, save and harvest water, run an environment club or awareness campaign (also clean-ups).

front: Why is wildlife part of heritage as well as a resource?
back: It belongs to the nation, brings tourism income, is linked to totems and culture, and must be passed on to future generations.
